patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Chronosphere share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose AppDynamics only if your buying job matches “Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33” rather than Chronosphere's shape. Choose Chronosphere only if your buying job matches “Control-plane observability for high-cardinality Prometheus-class telemetry — contact sale” rather than AppDynamics's shape. Workflow advantage differs because AppDynamics is shaped for Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium ( whereas Chronosphere is shaped for Control-plane observability for high-cardinality Prometheus-class tele. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Chronosphere share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: AppDynamics is Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33/vCPU/mo annual; Enterprise $50/vCPU; often Cisco ; Chronosphere is Control-plane observability for high-cardinality Prometheus-class telemetry — contact sales / pilot (typically free 2–3 weeks). Does not out.
- Researched limits: AppDynamics — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Chronosphere — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6).

Limitations — AppDynamics: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); $6/vCPU Infrastructure is not the APM-relevant floor — Premium $33 is; Chronosphere: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); No public list price — do not invent a host or GB floor.

Poor-fit cases: AppDynamics is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Chronosphere is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Avoid AppDynamics if you actually need Chronosphere's motion (Control-plane observability for high-cardinality Prometheus-class telemetry — co)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
